title: Production Engineer - Manufacturing
summary: A production engineer runs a manufacturing line day to day so that it meets its output, quality and safety targets. Early-career production engineers work in the plant's production team under a production manager, planning shifts, tracking OEE (how much of planned time a machine makes good parts) and fixing line problems with lean tools.
dailyDuties: Plan the shift's production and allocate operators to machines
Track hourly output, OEE and downtime against line targets
Set and check process parameters with quality and maintenance
Run kaizen and 5S activities on the line
Solve repeat problems with why-why and fishbone analysis
Book production and scrap in SAP or the plant ERP
Share the daily production MIS with the production manager

skills.expectation: Plan daily and shift production to meet line targets
Track OEE, downtime and cycle time and act on the biggest losses
Know the machining, assembly or fabrication processes run on the line
Run kaizen and waste-reduction ideas on the line
Use why-why, fishbone and Pareto to solve repeat line problems
Keep the line safe with PPE, work permits and near-miss reporting
Maintain the production MIS and daily reports in Excel
Brief operators and coordinate with quality, maintenance and stores
Check parts and fixtures against drawings
Lead a shift of operators and contract workers
Enter production orders and confirmations in SAP PP or the plant ERP
Read control charts for critical process parameters
Contribute to Six Sigma projects on yield or scrap
Plan maintenance slots with the maintenance team

certifications.why: Shows SAP PP knowledge for plants that run on SAP, though it is aimed at consultants rather than shop-floor engineers
